Introducing MySQL 9.7 LTS: New Features for Modern Application Development

Tuesday, May 12, 2026
Topics: MySQL Enterprise Edition, Performance & Scalability, Security, REST, JSON

Join us on May 12 for an in-depth look at MySQL 9.7 LTS, the latest long-term support release built with a strong developer focus. In this webinar, we will explore the newest innovations designed to help organizations build, scale, and secure modern applications faster.

Discover what is new in MySQL along with advancements in MySQL Server REST Service, the Hypergraph optimizer, and security including dynamic data masking and OpenID authentication. We will also cover powerful developer-centric enhancements such as the in-database JavaScript programming language and JSON duality, as well as the latest features, bug fixes, and security updates included in the release.

Whether you are a developer, architect, DBA, or IT leader, this session will show you how MySQL 9.7 LTS can help you accelerate application development while improving performance, flexibility, and security.

WHO:

  • Jayant Sharma, Senior Director, MySQL Product Management
  • Mike Frank, Director, MySQL Product Management

WHERE:

Simply access the web seminar from the comfort of your own office.
